scope.what_it_is: selection of an object-scale test that an isolated source could replay as measured
what_it_is_not: prediction of the fire of an item from material, temperature, ventilation and oxygen

species: none is in the file

version_policy.rule: values of TN 2303 (2025) and of the FCD pages (2026) are never combined in one quantity
version_policy.cause_of_the_2025_to_2026_change: not demonstrated (review of 2026-09-29); not explained here
version_policy.per_observable: the block applies to the species totals of the runs it touches; it does not by itself invalidate HRR

criteria_declared_before_evaluation.reproduction: peak, time to peak and total heat of the rebuilt table inside the expanded uncertainty printed on the page
criteria_declared_before_evaluation.species_totals: own reconstruction inside the expanded uncertainty printed on the page, the rule of the review of 2026-09-29
criteria_declared_before_evaluation.version_consistency: the printed 2025 CO yield inside its own rounding of the 2026 value, the rule of 2026-09-29
criteria_declared_before_evaluation.repeat_runs: difference of two printed values against the root sum of squares of their expanded uncertainties
criteria_declared_before_evaluation.note: no threshold was chosen in this phase; every criterion is a published uncertainty or a rule of an earlier review

unknown_in_every_nist_run: numeric mass against time (load cell): Tests 1 to 24 publish it only as figures, Tests 25 to 48 did not measure it
elemental composition, moisture and the share of each material in the item
HCN and any other species against time; HCN exists only as a 2025 whole-test value
soot composition; the published soot yield comes from laser extinction
whether each 1 Hz sample is instantaneous or an average, and which delay and response corrections were applied
what the burner channel reads when no burner is declared
ambient temperature and humidity of each run
the combustible share of the initial mass

contract_for_the_next_engine_change.module: one new isolated pure module, sibling of the prescribed mass release; no existing module is edited
why_not_the_existing_contracts: the per-object hrr_curve of the engine is a sharing weight of the room fire, capped and held at its last value; it replays nothing
the prescribed mass release needs an initial mass and a kg/s program of a component with CHO chemistry; this run has no numeric mass series and no approved composition
contract_for_the_next_engine_change.owner: one owner id: the item as tested, whole

measured: HRR against time, 1 Hz, ignition to fire out, of one run
assumed: negative samples are noise and are set to zero

contract_for_the_next_engine_change.time_origin: ignition event of the source run
contract_for_the_next_engine_change.outside_support: refused; no extrapolation and no hold of the last value
contract_for_the_next_engine_change.igniter: inside the measured curve and not separable; about 1e-4 of the energy
checkable_budget: energy delivered equals the integral of the table
integral inside the published total and its uncertainty
pending_decisions: what the source does when the compartment cannot supply the oxygen
how the room fire and this source coexist
not_approved: any item other than the one tested
any regime other than open air
